---
name: Engineering work item
about: Propose a bounded implementation, specification, or verification task
title: "task: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Goal

State the outcome, not only the intended code change.

## Invariant or contract

What must remain true?

## Scope

List included and explicitly excluded work.

## Dependencies

Link parent issues, specifications, and prerequisite work.

## Negative cases

Which malformed, unauthorized, stale, conflicting,
or resource-exhaustion cases must be rejected?

## Acceptance criteria

Use objective conditions that can be reviewed and tested.

## Verification and evidence

Name commands, Host/QEMU/hardware profiles,
exact outputs, and known limitations.

## Documentation

List specifications, status, roadmap, ADR,
and traceability entries that must change.
